QUOTE: A build through an outdated process would run old pipeline logic and re-stamp the index with it, dropping layers. `stale_code_refusal` (`freshness.py`) refuses writes in that case
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer states that builds from a stale process run old logic, but never says reads stay current because query tools open the database per call. It only mentions that reads are "from the index" and that line numbers may be off, so the read/write asymmetry is absent.
